messages:
Tara (CS): Heads-up — Parhelion onboarding saw a latency jump this morning, P99 went from ~1.2s to ~1.8s after the traffic ramp. Renewal contact flagged this as a risk if we don't show improvement.
Leo (Eng): I looked — they're on model `rw-base-3b`. We can recommend: quantize to int8 and route to `rw-3b-compact-int8` as a canary. That should cut compute and improve latency.
Matt (Solutions): Important: Parhelion is sensitive to small semantic shifts. Can we run an A/B on their eval set first (5k requests or a representative sample)?
Dina (SRE): Routing suggestion: prefer dedicated pool with a hosted fallback. Start canary at 10%, monitor latency + nerrs. Also increase autoscale min to avoid cold starts.
Tara (CS): Customer question: they need deterministic-ish behavior for a subset of prompts. Any regression risk with int8?
Leo (Eng): Small risk, but with per-layer calibration + a 100-prompt regression check we should catch obvious drift. Plan: eval harness (100 prompts for quick sanity) + 5k sample full A/B. ETA for quick sanity: 48h.
Matt (Solutions): Quick back-of-envelope: int8 + compact variant tends to reduce P95 ~25–35% and token cost ~40%. If true, that's a strong renewal talking point.
OpsBot: Automated snapshot: telemetry -> https://console.redwood.ai/clients/parhelion/telemetry (p99 spike at 08:14 UTC).
Leo (Eng): Proposed rollout config: ```json
{  "canary_percent": 10,  "model": "rw-3b-compact-int8",  "fallback": ["rw-base-3b"],  "route_policy": "latency_prefer",  "monitor": ["latency_p99","error_rate","semantic_regressions"]}
```
Dina (SRE): I'll add an alert: trigger if p99 > 1.5s for 15m and auto-failover to hosted. Also setting a temporary scale-up for the dedicated pool during canary window.
Tara (CS): Customer comms plan: I'll ask Parhelion PM for signoff on the canary. Timeline: eval (48h) -> canary 10% (24h) -> expand if metrics good. I'll also offer a rollback window.
Matt (Solutions): Add a customer note: expect up to 5–10% change on rare prompts; we'll include rollback within 1 hour if they see regressions.
Leo (Eng): I'll drop the quant artifacts + evaluation output in the shared folder and post results here when ready. @Tara please ping the PM for signoff.
Tara (CS): Will do. Sharing final plan in the onboarding tracker after PM ok. Thanks all :thumbsup:
